command:
set -euo pipefail
STAMP=$(date -u +%Y%m%dT%H%M%SZ)
D=/var/lib/trap/retests/$STAMP
mkdir -p "$D/baseline"
date -u +%FT%TZ > "$D/test-start.txt"
printf '%s' "$D" > /var/lib/trap/current-retest-dir
tar -czf "$D/baseline/source.tar.gz" -C /opt/trap .
cp /etc/adaptive-defender/live.json /etc/trap/trap.json /etc/suricata/rules/et-open-selected.rules "$D/baseline/"
systemctl stop adaptive-defender trap-dashboard
tar -xf /tmp/trap-new-source.tar -C /opt/trap
cd /opt/trap
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests > "$D/unit-tests.txt" 2>&1 || { cat "$D/unit-tests.txt"; exit 1; }
cat "$D/unit-tests.txt"
systemctl start adaptive-defender trap-dashboard
suricatasc -c command-list > "$D/suricata-control.txt" 2>&1 || true
sh /opt/trap/deploy/install-dashboard-helpers.sh --update-rules 2>&1 | tee "$D/install-helpers.txt"
systemctl is-active trap-apply-rules.path
cat /var/lib/trap/rules/result.json
grep 'sid:2006546' /etc/suricata/rules/et-open-selected.rules
sha256sum /etc/adaptive-defender/live.json > "$D/engine-config-after-install.sha256"
printf 'RETEST_DIR=%s\n' "$D"
